Legionnaires’ disease outbreak: Third person dies in New York City — what you need to know about the deadly infection
articles.description: New York City health officials have reported a third fatality linked to Legionnaires' disease on the Upper East Side, with over seventy residents falling ill, some necessitating hospitalization. As the city undertakes thorough cleaning and disinfection of affected water systems, the incidence of new cases is reportedly declining, but continued vigilance is essential.

articles.title: Planning a UAE trip? Here's how the 5-year tourist visa works

Visitors can stay up to ninety days per visit, extendable by another ninety days. Applicants need a valid passport, insurance, and bank statements showing a minimum balance. Applications can be submitted through digital platforms and customer service centers.
